page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.6xlarge is an enterprise-grade, general-purpose virtual machine deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor configured with 12 physical cores and 24 vCPUs via hyperthreading, backed by dedicated CPU allocation. Hardware-level acceleration features include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI vector instruction sets, alongside AES-NI and SHA-NI cryptographic extensions. Cache architecture provides 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache.

System memory consists of 96.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio at 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance comes with no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operating systems and persistence. Networking baseline bandwidth is rated at 12 Gbps, while public IPv4 addresses are not included complimentary.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent mid-tier performance across synthetic compute and operational evaluations. The instance recorded a multi-core stress-ng metric of 23,311.6 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11,900.0, aligning with the expected throughput of a 24-thread configuration. Memory operations achieved 127.7 GB/s in large-block read bandwidth and 63.99 GB/s in write bandwidth. In application simulations, the server handled 23.52 million Redis SET operations per second and delivered a static web serving rate of 25.51 GB/s. Machine learning inference on smaller models demonstrated notable efficiency, achieving 294.62 tokens per second on text generation using a 135M model, while larger 7B models reached 13.1 tokens per second.

The 1:4 CPU-to-memory configuration delivers qualitative cost efficiency for standard enterprise production tasks by avoiding overprovisioned memory or dedicated accelerator premiums. However, workloads requiring intensive IOPS or ultra-low storage latency will require external storage consideration due to the absence of integrated local NVMe disks. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.6xlarge is well aligned for mid-tier relational databases, enterprise web applications, CI/CD compilation, and lightweight CPU-based inference workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server offering 24 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. Operating under the KVM hypervisor, it features a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, a 48 MB L3 cache, and instruction support including AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI. The instance features a 12 Gbps baseline network interface, contains no integrated local storage, and includes no hardware GPUs. Benchmark evaluations show balanced performance across CPU and memory tests, scoring 11,900.0 on Geekbench multi-core and maintaining strong text generation output on compact language models. The lack of onboard storage makes it reliant on external block volumes, but its resource distribution offers solid efficiency for enterprise application tiers, web serving, container clusters, and standard database workloads.
